title: String 编码转换：int / embstr / raw
expected_output:
String 编码转换 (OBJ_ENCODING):
  SET k 123 -> int
  SET k 'hello' -> embstr
  SET k 'xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx' -> embstr
  SET k 'xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx' -> raw
  SET k 'short' -> embstr
  触发转换: APPEND 到 embstr 会先转 raw 再追加(embstr 只读紧凑)
  长度44 -> embstr; 长度45 -> raw (44 来自 64B jemalloc - robj16 - sdshdr8(3B) - 1B)
